title: What is the EY and EY-Parthenon interview process, and how should you prepare?
description: How EY consulting and its strategy arm EY-Parthenon hire: two to three rounds of behavioural, case and group case interviews, and how to prepare.
hook: EY organises its early careers around service lines, and EY-Parthenon, its strategy arm, runs a noticeably harder process than the wider consulting business. Here is what to expect.
body:
Which EY are you applying to?

EY's early-career service lines include Assurance, Consulting, EY-Parthenon and Tax. EY-Parthenon is the strategy arm, and its process is meaningfully harder than EY Consulting's.

The usual steps at EY-Parthenon

Prep guides describe two to three rounds, mixing behavioural interviews, case interviews and group cases, typically taking four to eight weeks from application to offer. Expect questions on why EY-Parthenon and why consulting before the case.

The cases

EY-Parthenon cases are usually candidate-led, and their difficulty and evaluation are closer to MBB than to a typical Big Four interview.

How to prepare

  • Prepare as you would for MBB cases: structure, drive, maths and a clear recommendation.
  • Practise a group case, since many processes include one.
  • Give fit preparation equal time to cases.

Sources

  • Hacking the Case Interview: EY-Parthenon strategy case interview
  • Hacking the Case Interview: EY-Parthenon case interview
  • StrategyCase: Big 4 case interviews

Checked November 2026. Processes change by office and year, so always confirm with the firm's own careers page and your recruiter.

Practise the commercial decision behind the numbers

A suitable strategy practice prompt is: should a regional food producer acquire its distributor? Work through the standalone economics, synergies, integration costs and alternatives. If the distributor earns £3 million EBITDA and comparable businesses trade around six times EBITDA, a very rough enterprise-value reference is £18 million. That is a starting point, not a purchase recommendation: debt, working capital, cash conversion and integration risk matter.

Now ask whether vertical integration creates genuine value. If buying the distributor saves £1 million annually but needs £4 million of new working capital and disrupts relationships with other producers, the answer becomes less obvious. Compare the deal with renegotiating terms or using a different partner.

EY-Parthenon and other EY groups recruit for different work, so do not overgeneralise one advertised process. Prepare tailored case analyses, concise recommendations and examples of your own decisions. Check the specific office's current assessment instructions before relying on claims about numbers of rounds or online test formats.
